description: Action reuse assessment: extend existing adapter validation using validate_upload_limit and validate_file_size; expose validate_files/2 for maps with name/filename and size (including metadata). No ZAQ dependency, transport, materialization or state. Return :ok or error for batch; byte validation at delivery remains authoritative. Add async boundary/error tests. Module context: adapter owns normalization and limits; tool owns authorization; Channels owns destination resolution. Unknown size must fail explicitly when this adapter validates.
title: Add Mattermost metadata-only file validation
